bibliographic-data.invention-title: VERFAHREN, VORRICHTUNGEN UND SYSTEME ZUR DETEKTION VON DRUCKDEFEKTEN UND VERUNREINIGTEN KOMPONENTEN EINES DRUCKERS
PROCÉDÉS, APPAREILS ET SYSTÈMES DE DÉTECTION DE DÉFAUTS D'IMPRESSION ET DE COMPOSANTS CONTAMINÉS D'UNE IMPRIMANTE
METHODS, APPARATUSES, AND SYSTEMS FOR DETECTING PRINTING DEFECTS AND CONTAMINATED COMPONENTS OF A PRINTER

abstract.p: A method for printing defect detection includes processing and analyzing a difference image obtained by comparing an image scanned with a verifier to a reference image. The detected defects are grouped, and the grouping is refined. Confidence level values are then assigned to the refined groups, and analysis is performed to determine if one or more servicing actions should be taken.
